GenAiFunction.description: Generates a concise customer-facing summary of a Truist Knowledge Article. Use this action when you need to present Knowledge content in a conversational, easy-to-read format. Pass the article title and body text retrieved via Search Knowledge.

inputs.definition: The title of the Knowledge Article to summarize.
The full or partial body of the Knowledge Article to summarize. Recommended: up to 3000 characters for best output quality.

outputs.definition: The generated 150–250 word customer-facing summary of the Knowledge Article.
